rules.rationale: Expands the named sortArrayLambda proof term into the exact translated Python lambda AST; it introduces syntax rather than an execution rule or mathematical fact.
Expands sortArrayBody into the translated return statement and nested sorted calls, defining a named program-body term.
Defines sortArrayClosure by packaging the parameter, previously defined body, and lexical environment into a closure value.
Defines the named sortArrayModule term as the module AST containing the target function definition.
Defines the named popcountKeyClosure proof term as the closure value produced from the annotated lambda.
Defines the mathematical output summary sortArraySpec as the composition of the supplied sortVS and sortKeyVS summaries with the named key closure.
Provides the empty-sequence base equation for the recursively defined allNonNegativeInts domain predicate.
Provides the integer-head recurrence for allNonNegativeInts by checking non-negativity and recursively processing the tail.
Completes the structural definition of allNonNegativeInts with an owise equation returning false for a non-integer head.
